result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. Only a couple of minor cosmetic issues were found: the profile avatar in the header appears empty, and the first restaurant card image looks like a washed-out placeholder inconsistent with the other cards.

issues.description: The circular avatar in the top-right corner is blank (plain gray circle with only a notification dot), suggesting the profile image or initials failed to load or were never set.
issues.suggestion: Show a fallback such as the user's initials or a generic person icon inside the avatar circle when no profile photo is available.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card image in 'Fastest near you' has a flat light-gray background and washed-out look, visually inconsistent with the richer, darker photography of the adjacent cards, making it appear like a broken or placeholder image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the correct high-quality image loads for this restaurant, or apply consistent image treatment (background, contrast) across all carousel cards.
